name: env-tiers
description: Directory-derived three-tier local environments (worktree dev -> UAT -> prod) with a prod guardrail hook, for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Directory-derived dev/UAT/prod tiers with a prod guardrail
interface.longDescription: Skills for laying out three local environment tiers whose identity comes from the directory name, wiring a project-local guard hook that blocks irreversible prod commands, running the branch flow that keeps an escape hatch open, and standing up a UAT tier without silently inheriting production side effects.
defaultPrompt: Set up dev/UAT/prod tiers for this project.
Stand up a UAT environment alongside production.
